summary_en: 1,100,000 shares (2.7% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) up to ¥500M. Execution window 14 Aug – 10 Sep 2026. Open-market purchases on TSE. Rationale: capital-efficiency gains and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, the board of PLAID, Inc. (ticker 4165, TSE Growth) approved the acquisition of treasury shares under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act and the company's articles of incorporation (Article 41). The company will acquire up to 1,100,000 ordinary shares representing approximately 2.7% of shares outstanding (41,084,805 ex-treasury as of 30 June 2026) for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥500 million. Purchases will be executed via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the window of 14 August through 10 September 2026. The board cited improvement in capital efficiency, shareholder returns, and flexible capital-allocation execution as the rationale. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 185,858 treasury shares.
